code:
def sinusoidal_pe(seq_len, d_model):
    pos = torch.arange(seq_len).unsqueeze(1).float()
    i = torch.arange(d_model // 2).float()
    angle = pos / (10000 ** (2 * i / d_model))
    pe = torch.zeros(seq_len, d_model)
    pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(angle)
    pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(angle)
    return pe   # (seq_len, d_model)
caption: Fixed sine/cosine waves at different frequencies per position.

code:
token_emb = embedding(tokens)
# (batch, seq_len, d_model)

pe = sinusoidal_pe(seq_len, d_model)
x = token_emb + pe
# same shape -- position injected elementwise
caption: d_model never changes; position rides along inside the same vector.
